note: Runtime-loaded audio-content URL patterns. Used by the audio demotion fix so that podcast/audio results arriving through the GENERAL web result set (e.g. a podcasts.apple.com URL returned by SearXNG, which is NOT tagged with an audio source) are still recognized as audio results and demoted for non-audio queries. This is a structural allow-list of platforms the engine explicitly treats as 'audio surfaces', not a per-query tuned list — same approach as VIDEO_HOSTS.
